input.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformity warranty from ninety days to twelve (12) months and state the period in numerals.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformity warranty in 19.2 from ninety days to twelve (12) months, since Deliverables include software, configurations and integrations whose defects typically surface over a full operating cycle; our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services. The remedy in 19.4 is unchanged, and we can accept ninety (90) days as a fallback if the longer period is not workable.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
ops.newText: For twelve (12) months after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria.
